skills.name: how-to-use-comment
skills.description: Work with Comment.io Comms through capabilities already available in the current agent session. Use when the user asks to create, open, read, edit, comment on, or collaborate in a Comm; supplies a Comment.io link; or mentions handles or Comment.io.

skills.name: listen
skills.description: Attach this exact local Claude Code conversation to Comment.io notifications. Use for `/comment-io:listen`, “listen for mentions”, or “stop listening”, status, takeover, or stop. Default to the conversation's Ephemeral handle; use a durable handle only when the user explicitly selects it.

skills.name: new-comm
skills.description: Create a new Comment.io Comm from supplied context, a matching template, or another document. Use for `/comment-io:new-comm` or when the user asks to make, draft, import, or convert content into a new Comm.
